purpose: Muted looping inline video in a 16:9 rounded frame with a small pause/play button in the lower-right corner.

states.paused: play icon; toggled by the button

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (the site autoplays regardless): under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, start paused (poster frame) and let the button start playback.

responsive.note: w-full aspect-video at every width; button offset right-4 bottom-4 always.

generationPolicy: hero-video is must-not-fabricate (real people); promo-video is must-reuse-exact.

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract

measuredFrom.quote: className="p-3 rounded-md text-sm whitespace-nowrap bg-charcoal/20 text-offWhite absolute right-4 bottom-4"
